about: Cian Healthcare Ltd is a BSE-SME listed pharmaceutical-formulations manufacturer with own /franchise brands, third-party manufacturing, institutional/government supply and exports. It makes tablets, capsules, soft-gels, liquid orals, ointments/creams, sachets and cosmetics across gynaecology, haematinic, cardio-diabetic, orthopaedic, paediatric, derma-cosmetic, antibiotic, CNS, vitamins and nutrients.
